purpose: Evidence-backed names applied to IDA-created functions that had no surviving ELF symbol.
policy: These aliases are analysis labels, not recovered source names. The evidence is recorded so a later pass can correct a label without confusing it with an imported ELF symbol.

labels.name: TGameEnvironment_emit_onFolderLog
evidence: Builds the literal onFolderLog
Invokes the universe event with one string argument

labels.name: TGameEnvironment_emit_onRCChat
evidence: Builds the literal onRCChat
Invokes the universe event with one string argument

labels.name: TClient_handleServerLoginSignature
evidence: Stores the incoming value in TClient::serversignature
Invokes the onServerLogin event

labels.name: TClient_beginUpdatePackageDownload
evidence: Looks up or adds a TUpdatePackage
Initializes its download counters and requested filename

labels.name: TClient_continueDownloadQueue
evidence: Removes completed entries from the old request set
Requests the next update or download file

labels.name: TClient_beginBigFileDownload
evidence: Initializes big-file bookkeeping
Clears the cached stream and advances onDownloadAction

labels.name: TClient_finishDownloadFile
evidence: Completes a requested file
Handles .gupd completion and validates the file key

labels.name: TClient_finishFileDownload
evidence: Invokes onFileDownloaded
Saves the cached stream and advances the download action

labels.name: TClient_sendHaveWindow
evidence: Calls TClient_sendHaveWindow with the current script window name

labels.name: TClient_sendWindowList
evidence: Builds a comma-text window list
Calls TClient_sendWindowList

labels.name: TGUIScriptLoader_finishServerListConnect
evidence: Hides the connecting window
Invokes onServerListerConnect
Sets allowpreloginreconnects to -1

labels.name: TGUIScriptLoader_showAdministratorMessage
evidence: Adds line endings to the supplied text
Shows it with the Administrator Message title

labels.name: TClient_processClientsideTrigger
evidence: Uses the clientside trigger type
Looks up the player and attaches a TClientSideTrigger

labels.name: TGUIScriptLoader_runFailedsafeConnectorIfNoClient
evidence: Calls runFailedsafeConnector only when the global client is absent

labels.name: TClient_setEncryptionIn
evidence: Forwards the three string arguments to TGraalConnection_setEncryptionIn

labels.name: TClient_handleUpdatePackageDownloaded
evidence: Saves the package version
Invokes onUpdatePackageDownloaded and onPackagesDownloadComplete

labels.name: TClient_finishCachedFile
evidence: Saves and updates the cached file
Routes .gupd files to updatePackageFailed or the normal download action

labels.name: TClient_processFileChunk
evidence: Emits onFileChunkReceived
Builds the cached file state used by the file-download callbacks

labels.name: TClient_dispatchEncodedFileChunk
evidence: Checks the encoded stream and payload strings
Forwards valid input to TClient_processFileChunk

labels.name: TClient_handleServerLoginPacket
evidence: Decodes the first packet character into serversignature
Invokes onServerLogin

labels.name: TClient_parseEncodedFileChunk
evidence: Decodes the five-character numeric prefix
Passes the decoded identifier and two substrings to TClient_processFileChunk

labels.name: TClient_setServerWarpDestination
evidence: Stores the incoming packet string in TClient::serverwarpdestination
Referenced by the packet-handler table

labels.name: TClient_applyPlayerProperties
evidence: Forwards the property string to TPlayer_setProperties
Clears the first-properties flag

labels.name: TClient_handleMapWarpPacket
evidence: Decodes five coordinate and map fields
Forwards the selected tile and map data to the level transition helper

labels.name: TClient_handleClientsideTriggerPacket
evidence: Decodes the trigger client ID, coordinates, and class strings
Forwards the result to TClient_processClientsideTrigger

labels.name: TClient_setInDataHandlersFromArray
evidence: Reads serialized handler pairs
Stores handlers in data_TClient_indatahandlers and handles special encryption, raw-length, and ping entries

labels.name: TClient_clearInDataHandlers
evidence: Clears the 256-entry inbound handler array

labels.name: TClient_addWeapon
evidence: Parses a packed weapon string
Calls TPlayer_addWeapon for the active player

labels.name: TClient_loadEncryptedScript
evidence: Decodes the script version, key, checksum, and target type
Calls TServerWeapon_loadScriptEncrypted2 or TScript_checkRequestScript

labels.name: TClient_setEncryptedScript
evidence: Decodes the script version, key, checksum, and target type
Calls TServerWeapon_setEncryptedScript2 or TScriptUniverse_addEncryptedClassScript

labels.name: TClient_deleteWeapon
evidence: Calls TPlayer_deleteWeapon for the active player

labels.name: TClient_setDisconnectReason
evidence: Stores the incoming value in data_TClient_disconnectreason

labels.name: TClient_setServerOptions
evidence: Decodes the five-character option value
Stores it in data_TClient_serveroptions

labels.name: TClient_enableGraal2002ServerMode
evidence: Sets data_TClient_graal2002server to one

labels.name: TClient_setTimeVar
evidence: Decodes the four-character time value
Stores it in data_TTime_timevar

labels.name: TClient_setBigFileSize
evidence: Decodes the big-file size
Stores it in data_TClient_bigfilesize and advances TClient_onDownloadAction

labels.name: TClient_setEncodedFileKey
evidence: Decodes the resource key and checksum fields
Calls TResourceFunctions_setEncodedFileKey and advances TClient_onDownloadAction

labels.name: TClient_requestGameFile
evidence: Parses a game-file request
Strips the filename and calls THTTPRequest_requestURLAsGameFile

labels.name: TClient_handleMapLevelPacket
evidence: Recognizes .gmap data
Calls TPlayer_enterServerLevel after parsing the map-level packet

labels.name: TClient_setServerLevelFile
evidence: Normalizes and stores TClient::serverlevelname
Selects a .gmap or level resource and updates TClient::serverlevel

labels.name: TClient_handlePlayerLoginLogout
evidence: Looks up players by ID or account name
Updates properties and invokes onPlayerLogin or onPlayerLogout

labels.name: TClient_handleGaniScript
evidence: Handles the gani:: update prefix
Adds class scripts, loads animation data, saves encrypted scripts, and reloads animation

labels.name: TClient_handleGaniUpdate
evidence: Parses a gani update
Loads the resulting animation from the assembled string

labels.name: TClient_setGhostMode
evidence: Decodes the incoming value
Stores it in data_TClient_ghostmode

labels.name: TClient_setGhostMessage
evidence: Stores the incoming value in data_TClient_ghostmessage

labels.name: TClient_handleSignImages
evidence: Calls TPlayer_parseSignImages for the active player
Stops walking when the packet requests it

labels.name: TClient_clearLevelState
evidence: Clears active-player weapons and every level and map NPC list
Clears global NPC and script-universe player lists

labels.name: TClient_logGameEcho
evidence: Parses a game echo packet
Sends the resulting text to TLog_echo

labels.name: TClient_updateServerNpc
evidence: Removes packet framing
Forwards the update to sub_1EA1E0

labels.name: TClient_handleNpcMovement
evidence: Decodes NPC movement coordinates
Calls TServerNPC_addNPCMove

labels.name: TClient_addNpcToLevel
evidence: Finds or creates an NPC and selects its level
Adds it to the level and updates its gani lookup tree

labels.name: TClient_handleProjectile
evidence: Decodes projectile fields and resolves the firing player
Calls TServerLevel_shootProjectile

labels.name: TClient_freezePlayer
evidence: Sets the active player's freeze counter to 600
Sets the player action mode

labels.name: TClient_unfreezePlayer
evidence: Sets the active player's freeze counter to -1

labels.name: TClient_saveLevelEncrypted
evidence: Decodes a level identifier
Calls TServerLevel_SaveEncrypted

labels.name: TClient_setPlayerWeaponImages
evidence: Decodes a client ID
Updates the selected player's weapon images

labels.name: TClient_setNpcWeaponImages
evidence: Decodes an NPC ID
Updates the NPC's weapon images through TServerPlayer_setWeaponImgs
